"""The one module allowed to read the environment directly (CLAUDE.md > Engine manual, G2)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os


def dev_domain() -> str:
    """Compliant: env_reads_outside_settings must not report this file, even though it reads
    os.environ directly -- this is the one file the scan excludes by path."""
    return os.environ.get("KF_DEV_DOMAIN", "")
